   820→    #[must_use]

   827→    pub fn upgrade_once(mut self, post_phase: Phase, fork_epoch: Epoch) -> Self {
   828→        for (phase, field) in self.fork_epochs_mut() {
   829→            *field = match phase.cmp(&post_phase) {
   830→                Ordering::Less => GENESIS_EPOCH,
   831→                Ordering::Equal => fork_epoch,
   832→                Ordering::Greater => FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH,
   833→            };
   834→        }
   835→
   836→        self
   837→    }
